sentences.en: Wear safety glasses when you're grinding metal to protect your eyes.
sentences.zh: 打磨金属时戴上护目镜保护眼睛。

sentences.en: The lab requires all students to wear safety glasses during experiments.
sentences.zh: 实验室要求所有学生在实验期间佩戴护目镜。

sentences.en: Make sure you have a spare pair of safety glasses in case the others break.
sentences.zh: 确保备用一副护目镜以防万一其他眼镜坏了。
